## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## User or scientific impact

Explain which EAM workflow is affected and how behavior changes for users.

## Validation

List the checks, synthetic examples, script runs, or forward tests performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose.
- [ ] No private data, fitted samples, secrets, or generated caches are included.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` remains concise and all referenced paths resolve.
- [ ] Changed helper scripts were exercised on a small fixture.
- [ ] The Agent Skill validator passes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes user-visible behavior.
- [ ] Scientific claims state their assumptions and limitations.
- [ ] Attribution and licensing remain correct for adapted material.
